architecture_audit.charter_gate_position: highest normative boundary above action selection, Function OS execution, validation, and publication
architecture_audit.psi0_status: workflow orchestrator / algorithm protocol; not changed by this overlay
architecture_audit.function_os_status: execution capability; does not decide whether an action is worth doing
architecture_audit.validation_layer_status: checks artifacts, proofs, workflows, and claims without creating lower-layer truth

current_gaps.description: No explicit protocol for choosing a next action when goals, metrics, and paths are unstable.
No standard mechanism-map object for explaining what changed, how, under which conditions, and with which alternatives.
Review inputs do not yet require separation of artifact, claim, evidence, mechanism map, and failure conditions from proponent enthusiasm or expected conclusion.
AI output, repository artifacts, CI, external sources, real-world responses, human judgment, and independent review are not yet recorded as non-fungible calibration sources.
Positive evaluative words are not yet machine-checked for explicit object, criterion, version, test, and boundary binding.
